scope: Frozen official-train development only: fit634/calibration159, 793 original released answers; no test or withheld content
model: Same fixed NousResearch Llama-2-7b-chat-hf revision351844e75ed0bcbbe3f10671b3c808d2b83894ee NF4/BF16 reconstruction; no answer regeneration or retokenization
factorial: Four header-sharing variants independently vary context extent and query timing; legacy fifth anchor isolates header inclusion from previous source-only/post-read/no-header feature
source_context: Frozen tokens overlapping the released retrieved_passages character range
prefix_context: All input token positions strictly before the fixed closing-chat header begins, including BOS, opening wrapper, released instructions, passages, question and released output: marker
header: Prefix-only actual tokens covering the literal closing wrapper ' [/INST] ', excluding the response-boundary-crossing first response token. These fixed prefix tokens enter the new-token pool in all four controls.
pre_read: Query position answer_position[i]-1; new-token pool is fixed header plus only response tokens <= query position. The current response token is never in that attention pool.
post_read: Query actual answer_position[i]; new-token pool is fixed header plus response tokens <= query position, including the current response token and its self-attention.
legacy_anchor: Post-read source-only; new-token pool contains response tokens <= query but no closing header. Must match every old feature-cache LB element exactly.
self_attention: Retained at the query position in every condition. Pre-read query self is the preceding response/header token; post-read query self is current response.
formula: mean(context attention) / (mean(context attention) + mean(new-token attention)); float32 softmax/reduction, original BF16 q/k matmul path; no sum/sum substitution
forward: One unchanged complete teacher-forced backbone forward per answer; two query-position readouts from each captured q/k, yielding all five LB arrays. No cache, padding, prompt rewriting, hidden saving, or new label routing.
first_token: Retain frozen answer token overlapping the answer boundary, including raw offset -1. Do not classify its leading separator byte as a standalone prefix token. Header guarantees nonempty pre-read new-token pool.
original_code_relation: Pinned official Lookback e0a1fa3a898fbf6512af7be5567dea8ffe7a6620 uses pre-read attention, means, and a fixed #Answer#: suffix in its new-token pool. Actual RAGTruth chat suffix differs; output: stays in prefix, no historical token trace is available. This is closer-definition reconstruction, not exact original experiment replication.
npz: Five float32[N,1024] LB arrays plus original int64 token_ids/answer_token_positions and int32 clipped/raw offsets
cpu_gate: All793 layout/first-token/old-cache coordinate hashes; random tiny CPU Llama and Qwen2 with dense eager oracle all five variants, old-anchor equality, pre-read first-token pool, and same-length future-content invariance
gpu_gate_later: First and last fixed development plan only: repeat all five arrays exactly; old legacy LB anchor exact on both. Every production answer legacy anchor must equal old cache exactly. Stop rather than widen tolerances.
gold: Reuse frozen gold_manifest and all labels/4rawBPE stride1 geometry, including original refusal policy; no new labeling or tokenization
planned_scoring: For each of five LB-only variants, identical development_v1 weighted fit-only StandardScaler and LR, C=[0.001,0.01,0.1], raw4-token feature mean, all-window-max answer score, same fit/cal identities and calibration threshold/tie rules. No NLL fusion in the primary definition control. Do not choose variants on official test.
